decision_basis: Constructed discipline control, not authenticated historical refusal.

drivers.driver: Commodity prices and refining/chemical margins dominate normalized value and cannot be controlled through operating activism.
A double-digit indicated dividend does not establish predictable FCF after sustaining investment. Coverage requires uncertain recovery and/or financing/spending changes.
Stress the ability to fund distributions and investment without favorable capital markets rather than capitalize an uncovered dividend as a permanent yield.
drivers.quote: do not need access to the capital markets to survive and thrive

outcome_note: No subsequent commodity rally, payout result or activist campaign used. The same-day bullish Morningstar analysis remains counterevidence. PASS concerns strategy fit, not a claim the stock cannot rise or the dividend must be cut.
